What was the percentage increase in the number of mango trees planted in 2020 compared to the number of mango trees planted in 2018
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A table showing the number of trees of 3 different fruits, planted during 2018- 2022.

**Formula used:**

Percentage increase = (Mango in 2020 - Mango in 2018) / Mango in 2018 × 100

**Calculation:**

Percentage increase = (52000 - 40000) / 40000 × 100
